API reference¶

All REST API routes require authentication unless the endpoint is listed as an internal integration. The API uses Django REST Framework token or session authentication.

Authentication¶

POST /api/token/ accepts a username and password and returns a token.

Articles¶

  • GET /api/articles/ lists approved articles.

  • POST /api/articles/ lets a journalist create an independent article.

  • GET /api/articles/subscribed/ lists approved articles from a reader’s subscribed journalists and publishers.

  • GET /api/articles/<id>/ retrieves an article visible to the current role.

  • PUT or PATCH /api/articles/<id>/ updates an article when role and ownership rules permit it.

  • DELETE /api/articles/<id>/ deletes an article when role and ownership rules permit it.

  • POST /api/articles/<id>/approve/ approves an article for editors.

Newsletters and directory¶

  • GET /api/newsletters/ lists newsletters with approved articles or no articles. Journalists and editors may create newsletters.

  • GET /api/newsletters/<id>/ retrieves a newsletter. Editors and its author may update or delete it.

  • GET /api/publishers/ lists publishers.

  • GET /api/users/ lists user profiles.

Internal approval integration¶

POST /api/approved/ records an approved article. It is an internal endpoint and requires an X-Approval-Secret header. The shared secret must remain private and should be rotated for any deployment beyond local development.
